basics.name: Neil Foxcroft
basics.label: Backend Software Engineer
basics.pitch: I build the Java and Kotlin services that connect banks, retailers and their partners, and keep them running in production.
about: I'm a backend engineer at **Entelect** with 4.5+ years building Java and Kotlin Spring Boot microservices for banking and retail financial services. Most of my work sits where systems meet: the APIs, integrations and orchestration that let digital channels, partners and point-of-sale systems talk to each other.

Most recently, at **Shoprite Financial Services**, I owned the electricity supplier integrations for Namibia and Botswana end to end, from requirements and partner calls through release and production support. Before that I spent two years on value-added services at **Standard Bank**.
Away from the keyboard I climb, hike (most recently the whole Pacific Crest Trail), am learning to paint Warhammer miniatures, and tinker with a homelab.

work.name: Entelect
work.summary: Software consultancy. Placed with clients as a backend engineer, alongside work on Entelect's own initiatives.

engagements.name: Shoprite Financial Services
engagements.summary: Built Kotlin and Spring Boot services for electricity, airtime, insurance, gift cards and bill payments. Designed Backend-for-Frontend endpoints so Checkers Sixty60 could reuse point-of-sale transaction services, and owned the Namibia and Botswana electricity integrations end to end.

engagements.name: Standard Bank
engagements.summary: Developed Java and Spring Boot microservices for product catalogue, quote, order and settlement flows, and contributed to the MNO rewrite for airtime, data, SMS, electricity and lottery products. Migrated Angular front ends to micro-frontends in an Nx monorepo.

engagements.name: Entelect Challenge
engagements.summary: Maintained the AWS infrastructure behind the competition platform: game engine, website, player portal, forum and submissions. Led the cloud team for a year, owning deployment pipelines and production support.

education.summary: Specialised in AI, advanced databases, computer security and information systems engineering. Thesis: detecting StyleGAN-generated images with deep learning.

Alongside the degree I served two terms on the RAG Technical Committee. RAG (now JOOL) is one of the biggest charity drives in the Southern Hemisphere, and it was entirely student-run while I was there. The technical committee kept its events safe and helped maintain and develop the RAG Farm, its concert venue.
